steps: 1. Host with bots and enable **Bot Behavior Improvements** and **Bots Drink Surplus Ranger Ale**.
2. Place Ranger ale within normal follow range while any active teammate has fewer than three stacks. Repeat when the newest relevant stack has 50% duration or less; bots must leave both drops.

3. Give every active teammate all three defence and attack-speed stacks with strictly more than half their duration remaining, then place another ale in normal follow range. A bot may claim and drink this surplus drop.
4. Turn **Bots Drink Surplus Ranger Ale** off and repeat the surplus setup; the ale must remain human-reserved.
5. Run `/gt_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the newest log.
assertions: Only the fully stacked, over-half-duration all-team case permits consumption. Fewer-than-three, at-or-below-half, and child-disabled controls stay reserved, and the full regression report passes.
Harness: set team ale buff stacks/durations through BuffExtension, spawn ale, tick; assert consumption only in full-stack over-half case; policy table offline.
